senses.preferredTarget: to click the teeth three times
searchAliases: to click the teeth three times
senses.note: The first click in several transmitted versions belongs to the unnamed chief seat, not Dadian; both later make the same gesture, so each retained span is actor-checked.

explanationParts.corpusEarnedOpening: In the Dadian encounter, the chief seat and Dadian each click their teeth three times; Chaozong later appraises those clicks, and the unnamed questioning monk performs them anew before Qiran Zhi.
evidenceBody: The repeated gesture is not interchangeable with the bead count: the chief seat and Dadian each perform three audible tooth-clicks in the same inquiry.

draftEvidence.ZenBend: In the Dadian encounter, the chief seat and Dadian each click their teeth three times; Chaozong later appraises those clicks, and the unnamed questioning monk performs them anew before Qiran Zhi.
draftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The first click in several transmitted versions belongs to the unnamed chief seat, not Dadian; both later make the same gesture, so each retained span is actor-checked.

ComparedThings: to click the teeth three times
DifferentThingTest.Reason: The repeated gesture is not interchangeable with the bead count: the chief seat and Dadian each perform three audible tooth-clicks in the same inquiry.

draftEvidence.AliasRationale: The lookup keeps the performed tooth-click, the count of three, and the repeated gesture rather than the nearby bead count of one hundred and eight.

ModifierControls.Term: to click the teeth three times
